v28_origin.description: CYC4-002. Run it from chat. Expect BUNDLE_START with caller, channel=chat and permissionLevel=2, then the nested child's BUNDLE_START with channel=nested.

v28_origin_child.description: The nested child of v28_origin. Expect channel=nested on its BUNDLE_START.
